food_catalogues.name: Fresh Milk
food_catalogues.storage_guidance: Store in refrigerator at or below 4°C (40°F). Keep tightly closed in its original carton or bottle.

food_catalogues.name: Raw Chicken Breast
food_catalogues.storage_guidance: Store in refrigerator at or below 4°C (40°F). Keep wrapped securely on the lowest shelf to prevent juices dripping onto other foods.

food_catalogues.name: Raw Ground Beef
food_catalogues.storage_guidance: Store in refrigerator at or below 4°C (40°F) in original packaging or sealed airtight container.

food_catalogues.name: Fresh Fish Fillets
food_catalogues.storage_guidance: Store in refrigerator at or below 4°C (40°F) wrapped tightly or sealed in an airtight container.

food_catalogues.name: Fresh Shell Eggs
food_catalogues.storage_guidance: Store in refrigerator at or below 4°C (40°F) in their original carton on an inside shelf, not in the door.

food_catalogues.name: Fresh Cut Produce
food_catalogues.storage_guidance: Store cut vegetables and fruits in refrigerator at or below 4°C (40°F) in clean, covered containers.

food_catalogues.name: Frozen Vegetables
food_catalogues.storage_guidance: Keep frozen at or below -18°C (0°F) in airtight, moisture-resistant packaging.

food_catalogues.name: Cooked Leftovers
food_catalogues.storage_guidance: Refrigerate within 2 hours of cooking at or below 4°C (40°F) in shallow, airtight containers.

food_catalogues.name: Dry White Rice
food_catalogues.storage_guidance: Store in a cool, clean, and dry pantry location in an airtight container away from moisture, heat, and direct sunlight.

food_catalogues.name: Dry Pasta
food_catalogues.storage_guidance: Store in a cool, dry place in an airtight container to protect against humidity and pests.
